name: application-calendar-heat-legend-chart
title: Calendar Heat Legend Chart
description: A single-month calendar grid with intensity-colored day cells, correctly aligned weekday axis labels, and a numeric-bucket legend — framed as a chart, not a contribution strip.
useWhen: Reporting a single month's daily metric (deploys, incidents, orders) where the calendar date grid itself is the primary chart, with a numeric legend rather than a relative Less/More scale.
Users need to read an exact day-of-month value alongside its intensity, not just scan for streak patterns across many months.
avoidWhen: You need the GitHub-style multi-month contribution strip with a relative Less/More scale — use `Heatmap Calendar` for that framing instead.
The data isn't naturally daily/monthly — a generic `charts` bar or line chart communicates other cadences more directly.
responsiveBehavior: The 7-column grid scales its cell size with the card's width; keep the card at least ~280px wide so day numbers stay legible.
accessibility: Weekday header labels are always visible above the grid, giving every cell a positional (day-of-week) reference in addition to color.
Each cell shows its day-of-month number as text, not just an unlabeled colored square.
The legend uses discrete numeric buckets (0, 1–3, 4–6, 7–9, 10+) stated as text, not a color-only relative scale.

variants.title: Month intensity grid
variants.description: An August 2026 calendar grid with weekday-aligned day cells shaded by deploy count, and a five-bucket numeric legend.
accessibility: Every cell shows both its day number and legend-mapped intensity level as text/color together.

variants.title: Month intensity grid (Dark)
variants.description: Calendar heat legend chart adapted for dark surfaces, with intensity steps re-tuned for dark contrast.
accessibility: Cell fill colors and day-number text meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark card background.
